constructs Qwen's base model, an optimizer, or an image pipeline. Never saves
adapter tensors. Source checkpoints and existing entrypoints are read-only.

usage: smoke_adapter_v6.py [-h] --mode {single,dual} --model-path MODEL_PATH
                           [--condition-backend {native,champ}] [--use-depth]
                           [--image-size IMAGE_SIZE]
                           [--latent-size LATENT_SIZE] [--seed SEED]
                           [--device DEVICE] [--output OUTPUT]
                           [--skip-deepgen-equivalence]

Real DeepGen structural smoke test for Unified SMPL-X Adapter V6. Synthetic
prepared conditions exercise the ConditionBundle boundary. The script never
estimates SMPL-X, trains, creates an optimizer, or saves weights. Zero-
initialized heads must leave the frozen DeepGen result unchanged.

  --mode {single,dual}
  --model-path MODEL_PATH
  --condition-backend {native,champ}

  --latent-size LATENT_SIZE
  --seed SEED

                        backbone forwards.
